social.faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
social.faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about this directory
social.faq.a1: It is a wiki that collects threads, videos, and educational articles published by 0x Leñador on his networks, organized to facilitate your research.
social.faq.a2: The directory is updated automatically in real-time whenever 0x Leñador publishes new valuable content on his social networks.
social.faq.q3: How can I search for specific content?
social.faq.a3: You can use the search bar at the top to filter by keywords, titles, or specific topics within all the content.
social.faq.q4: Are the videos and articles complete here?
social.faq.a4: We show a summary or introduction. By clicking 'View', you will be redirected to the original platform (X or YouTube) to consume the full content.
social.faq.q5: What topics does 0x Leñador talk about?
social.faq.a5: Mainly about Web3, agentic economy, DeFi, blockchain games (like Sunflower Land), Bitcoin ecosystem, and decentralized finance.
